description: RC thermal model: V_term = V_cap - I*ESR(T). Extends F1a with Arrhenius ESR(T), temperature-dependent capacitance, and heat generation.

cell.name: Generic 3000 F EDLC cell (carbon/carbon, ~2.7 V class)
cell.source: Maxwell BCAP3000 datasheet; Conway (1999), Electrochemical Supercapacitors, Plenum; Berrueta et al. (2019), IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron.

leakage_resistance.note: Self-discharge resistance (T_ref); weakly temperature dependent, approximated constant

E_a_esr.note: Activation energy for ESR; EDLC ionic transport in porous carbon is weakly activated compared to batteries
E_a_esr.source: Berrueta et al. (2019), IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron. 66(6), 4750; Rafik et al. (2007), J. Power Sources 165, 928

alpha_C.note: Capacitance temperature coefficient; EDL capacitance increases ~0.3%/K due to electrolyte dielectric and ion mobility
alpha_C.source: Rafik et al. (2007), J. Power Sources 165, 928-934; Maxwell application note AN-1006

temperature.note: -40 to 65 degC; EDLC operates over very wide temperature range
